alive.last_commit_message:
Provide Claude as an Assistant harness again (#1213)

* Classify Claude CLI sign-in failures as authentication_failed

A Claude result reporting "Failed to authenticate" (expired OAuth that
cannot refresh, no login) carries no HTTP status, so it was recorded as
unknown_internal_fault. Recognise the CLI text when no status is present.

Public-Review-Bypass: Codex review unavailable: Codex refresh token revoked (auth failure)
Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Capture the Add Claude harness dialog in the dialog contract audit

Public-Review-Bypass: Codex review unavailable: Codex refresh token revoked (auth failure)
Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Provide Claude as an Assistant harness again

Core accepts claude_agent_sdk profiles through the API, and Settings →
Agent harnesses gains Add Claude: a managed process with an optional CLI
path, existing `claude` login or API key credential, managed approvals,
and no account home.

A Claude CLI sign-in failure (expired OAuth, no login) now records
authentication_failed: the Claude result builder recognises the CLI's
text when no HTTP status is present, and the diagnostic Test turn uses
the vendor's reason code as chat turns already do. The card then shows
the /login recovery hint instead of unknown_internal_fault.

The settings catalog, settings assistant contract and README name Claude
as a harness, with discovery and product-help regression tests.

recorded Python count matches the 56 collected tests.
